rationale: Builds on the reverse-tail recurrent baseline but decouples recurrence update gain from anchor-carry gain. The deepest recurrent pass stays fully active, while earlier recurrent blocks now ramp their carry path later than their update path. This is a compact, compile-stable curriculum change aimed at preserving the winning tail recurrence structure while reducing early anchor over-coupling that recent refresh/gate variants appear to have destabilized.
title: Staggered Tail Carry Curriculum
